transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm... well, my husband wanted me to come. It's about the kitchen. We started a remodel a while ago, and... well, it's been nearly two years now. I just know the contractor and some of the neighbors are... they're working together to keep it unfinished. To cheat us. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they keep making excuses, but... I know what's going on.
Do you think the contractor and neighbors would really be working together against you?

Well... yes. Like I said, I'm sure of it. It's been nearly two years now, and they've been quietly working together to cheat us. They just keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't really matter how many receipts my husband shows me, or... or what excuses they give. I just know.
Have you ever considered the possibility that the contractor and neighbors might not be working against you?
No. I mean... why would I? It's been two years. I told you, they're working together to cheat us. Keeping it half-wrong on purpose. The receipts don't change that. I just... I know what I know.
Do you think you're in danger from the contractor and neighbors?

Danger? No... I didn't say anything about being in danger. 

I just... they're cheating us out of our money. That's all it is. I don't think anyone is going to hurt me.
When did you first start thinking that the contractor and neighbors were working together against you?
About... a year and nine months ago, I suppose. It was right when the remodeling first started... on the kitchen and the garden. The house was just... disrupted. That's when it began.
Have your thoughts about the contractor and neighbors cheating you changed at all since you first started thinking that?

No... not really. It's been nearly two years now, and I'm still sure they're quietly working together to cheat us. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they always have excuses, but... it doesn't change anything. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. So, no. My thoughts haven't changed.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't think the contractor and neighbors were working against you?
No... I haven't. Like I said, it's been about a year and nine months... ever since the remodeling started and the house got all torn up. It's just been a constant thing since then.
Has there ever been a time, even for a short while, when you doubted that the contractor and neighbors were working together against you?

I thought I just answered this. No. I haven't doubted it. 

For nearly two years now, I've just been sure they're quietly working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me, or... or how many excuses those people on my block give. I know what's going on.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working together against you ever wavered, even for a moment?

I don't understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. No. It hasn't wavered. 

Like I just told you... for almost two years now, I've been completely sure they're working together to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. The receipts my husband shows me, their excuses... it doesn't change anything. I don't know how else to answer that.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working together against you ever stopped, even for a short time, since it first started?
I... I don't know what else you want me to tell you. No. It hasn't stopped. I really don't have anything else to say about it.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you're absolutely sure are true, but others might not agree with?
No. I just... I just have the situation with the house. That's all.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were absolutely sure were true, but others around you didn't agree with?
No. I just told you that. I don't... I don't have anything else. Just the house.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that you were completely sure were true, but others didn't agree with, besides the situation with the house?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. I already said no. It's just... just the house. That's it.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working against you to cheat you been present every day since it started?
Well... yes. It doesn't just stop. It's been going on for... I guess about a year and nine months now. Ever since that kitchen and garden remodeling started... disrupting the house.
Have you ever had any thoughts that you were completely sure were true, but others didn't agree with, that weren't about the house?
I don't... no. There isn't anything else. I really don't know how many different ways I can say it to you.
Has there ever been a day since you first thought the contractor and neighbors were working against you that you didn't think about it?

No... no, not really. It's just... always there. For nearly two years now, I've just known they're all quietly working together to cheat us. Keeping the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they keep giving excuses, but... I know what's happening. It doesn't just go away for a day.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working against you ever changed in intensity since it started?
I don't... I'm not really sure what you mean by intensity. It's just... what's happening. I haven't noticed it being any different.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working against you ever been considered a delusion by a mental health professional?
No... I haven't talked to anyone else about it. I don't really see people for... things like that. There's been no reason to.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working against you lasted for more than 3 months?
Yes... like I said, it's been much longer than three months. It's been about a year and nine months now. Just... ever since the kitchen and garden remodeling started disrupting the house.
